title: TitheTransaction
description: A record of a biblical giving transaction (tithe, offering, almsgiving, etc.) processed through the BibleFi protocol on Base chain. Fulfills Malachi 3:10: 'Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse.' Supports both manual and smart-contract-routed transactions.

sender_church_id.description: Links to church_record if church-to-church tithe

recipient_wallet.description: Wallet of the recipient church, ministry, or protocol treasury

amount_wei.description: Amount in wei (uint256 as string to avoid JavaScript precision loss). Convert: amount_wei / 10^decimals = token amount

amount_usd.description: USD equivalent at time of transaction

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID. BibleFi primary chain = Base mainnet (8453)

tx_hash.description: On-chain transaction hash on Base chain

transaction_type.description: Biblical category of giving. tithe = 10% of income per Malachi 3:10. firstfruits = first portion per Proverbs 3:9-10. offering = freewill gift per 2 Corinthians 9:7.

scripture_reference.description: Scripture backing this giving transaction. Recommended: Malachi 3:10 for tithes, Proverbs 3:9 for firstfruits, 2 Corinthians 9:7 for offerings, Luke 21:4 for widow's offering.

percentage_of_income.description: If provided, percentage of income this represents. 10.0 = traditional tithe per Malachi 3:10

is_recurring.description: Whether this is part of a recurring giving schedule

giving_strategy_id.description: Links to defi_strategy record if this tithe comes from yield generated by a BibleFi DeFi strategy

smart_contract_routed.description: Whether routed via BibleFi smart contract on Base chain

contract_address.description: BibleFi tithe router or splitter contract address on Base chain

attestation.description: On-chain attestation record for this giving transaction. Use attestation_type: eas_attestation for EAS on Base chain.
